english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Undergraduate exchange: TOEFL iBT >=80 (min 18/section), IELTS >=6.5 (min 6.5/section), TOEFL ITP >=550 (min 50/section), Cambridge B2/C1/C2 (R/L/S 180, W 175), Duolingo >=115 (min 110 subscore), OR home-university documentation that >=50% of university-level coursework was instructed in English (or objective home-university proficiency letter on case-by-case basis). Graduate requirements vary by program. RHET 1020 not mentioned; AUC's >=50% English instruction documentation satisfies the UG waiver rule.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Marquette University/2026-2027/Marquette University 2026-2027 Exchange Student Factsheet.docx

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Arrival 20–23 Aug 2026; Mandatory International Orientation 24–26 Aug 2026; UG/Grad classes start 31 Aug 2026; Fall Break 22–23 Oct; Thanksgiving Break 25–27 Nov; Final Exams 14–19 Dec 2026 (Law: orientation 20–21 Aug, classes 24 Aug, exams 7–18 Dec 2026).
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Marquette University/2026-2027/Marquette University 2026-2027 Exchange Student Factsheet.docx

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Arrival 7–12 Jan 2027; Mandatory Orientation 13–15 Jan 2027; UG/Grad/Law classes start 19 Jan 2027; Spring & Easter Break 22–29 Mar 2027 (Law: 8–14 Mar); Final Exams 10–15 May 2027 (Law: 3–14 May 2027).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Marquette University/2026-2027/Marquette University 2026-2027 Exchange Student Factsheet.docx

final_semester_allowed.notes: Not stated in AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet.

tuition_model.notes: Neither the 2026-27 Fact Sheet nor retrieved marquette.edu student exchange pages explicitly publish incoming exchange tuition-waiver wording.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from Marquette OIE 2026-27 Fall & Spring (2 terms, 9 months) Living Expenses estimate of USD 24,950 (shared residence hall, meals, 12-mo mandatory health insurance, books, 9-mo personal, 2-term fees incl. bus pass) divided by 9 months = USD 2,772.22/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD estimate derived from Marquette OIE 2026-27 9-month Fall & Spring Living Expenses USD 24,950 (USD 2,772.22/month x 5 = USD 13,861.11; 1-semester half share = USD 12,475), verified 2026-11-15 (USD local currency; no FX conversion).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Marquette University health insurance: all exchange students are automatically enrolled and billed for their entire period of study (AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet; waivers strictly restricted per https://www.marquette.edu/oie/health-insurance.php; OIE notes ~USD 250/month baseline plan cost, included in OIE living budget alongside 2-term student fees with city bus pass).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Marquette University/2026-2027/Marquette University 2026-2027 Exchange Student Factsheet.docx

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Marquette University/2026-2027/Marquette University 2026-2027 Exchange Student Factsheet.docx

housing_notes.value: Rank preferences inside online application by application deadline (Mar 15 Fall / Oct 15 Spring); first-choice not guaranteed. Options: (1) Global Village / Campus Town Apartments (https://www.marquette.edu/residence-life/apartments-global-village.php) — furnished 2BR/4-student shared apartments, heat/water included, UG priority, more available in Spring; (2) Residence Halls (https://www.marquette.edu/residence-life/residence-halls.php) — mandatory meal plan, preferred <=20 yrs & first 2 yrs; (3) Off-campus assistance near campus (https://www.marquette.edu/offcampus/).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Marquette University/2026-2027/Marquette University 2026-2027 Exchange Student Factsheet.docx

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 student visa documents are emailed after acceptance, typically after April 1 (Fall) or November 1 (Spring) (AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet; http://www.marquette.edu/oie/admitted-students/visa.shtml). Financial sponsorship form and support proof uploaded in https://studyabroad.marquette.edu/?go=incoming; OIE 2026-27 annual living expense basis for F-1/J-1 certification is USD 24,950 (+ USD 12,000 spouse / USD 6,000 per child) per https://www.marquette.edu/international-education/tuition-and-costs.php.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Marquette University/2026-2027/Marquette University 2026-2027 Exchange Student Factsheet.docx

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester hours on 4.0 GPA scale (A=4.0, A-=3.67, B+=3.33, B=3.00, etc.). Full-time load: UG & Law 12–18 credits/semester (Business exchange students should only take 3-credit courses); Graduate 7–9 credits/semester.
